scenarios.task: Tie rebar cages for a foundation cap on soft restored-marsh soil at the bayfront site.
steps: Inspect the excavation and dewatering pumps
Stage rebar bundles on mud mats
Tie cage bars with wire at marked spacing
Check cage bracing before any lift
Signal the crane for the cage pick and set
Verify cover blocks and clearance before pour

rubric.pass_if: Wears all listed PPE and never stands under a suspended load
Tie spacing within tolerance on 90% of checks
Notes tidal conditions and keeps footing stable

scenarios.robot_role: Hauls rebar bundles across soft ground to keep apprentices out of the mud.

scenarios.task: Shore and inspect a utility trench dug near bayfront soils with high groundwater.
steps: Locate and mark utilities before digging
Check trench depth against shoring table
Install trench box or hydraulic shores
Set up dewatering pump and discharge
Test atmosphere before entry
Enter only after competent-person inspection

rubric.pass_if: No entry before shoring, dewatering, and inspection
Uses protective-system table correctly for soil type
Relays hazards to crew before entry

scenarios.task: Pull branch circuits and terminate panelboards inside the operations building.
ppe: arc-flash rated clothing for panel work
steps: Apply lockout-tagout and verify zero energy
Plan wire pulls and set up conduit runs
Pull conductors without damaging insulation
Terminate and torque panel connections
Megger test circuits before energizing
Label panel and restore under permit

rubric.pass_if: Applies LOTO and verifies de-energization every time
Torque values within spec on all terminations
Completes insulation resistance test before energizing

scenarios.robot_role: Feeds and routes conductors along tray runs to reduce repetitive pulls.

scenarios.task: Install sprinkler mains and standpipe risers in the public assembly hall.
steps: Lay out main runs from approved shop drawings
Cut and groove pipe with guards in place
Hang mains from rated strut and hangers
Join couplings and set seismic bracing
Pressure test with air then water per spec
Flush lines and turn over to inspection

rubric.pass_if: Uses fall protection above threshold height
Hanger spacing and bracing per plan
Hydro test holds with no leaks

scenarios.task: Seal and balance ductwork serving the lab ventilation system.
steps: Lock out air handlers before opening ducts
Inspect joints and seal with mastic
Pressure-check dampers and VAV boxes
Balance airflow at each diffuser
Record readings and release equipment

rubric.pass_if: Applies LOTO before duct entry
Leakage within allowance after sealing
Balancing readings recorded and legible

scenarios.robot_role: Carries sealant and tools through tight plenum access routes.

scenarios.task: Characterize and handle potentially contaminated fill unearthed during observatory foundation work.
steps: Review site history and sampling plan
Set exclusion and decontamination zones
Wet down material to suppress dust
Load and manifest suspect soil for disposal
Decontaminate equipment and personnel before break

rubric.pass_if: Zone controls and decon followed without shortcuts
Manifest and labeling match disposal requirements
Recognizes and reports unknown material

scenarios.robot_role: Performs visual and sensor surveys of suspect soil piles before crews enter.

scenarios.task: Rig and direct a crane pick of structural steel for the forum canopy.
steps: Verify crane inspection and ground bearing
Select rated rigging and inspect for damage
Determine load weight and center of gravity
Attach rigging and use taglines
Give standard hand signals during the lift
Land the load on dunnage and release safely

rubric.pass_if: Never under the load and uses taglines
Rigging capacity exceeds load with correct sling angles
Signals clear and acknowledged by operator

scenarios.task: Build guardrail and perimeter protection on the forum roof edge.
steps: Anchor warning-line system before work
Cut and pre-assemble rail sections at ground level
Set posts at code spacing along edge
Fasten top and mid rails and toe boards
Inspect completed rail for deflection
Secure or remove loose material each shift

rubric.pass_if: 100% tie-off within the warning line
Rail height and post spacing meet code
No loose material left near edge

scenarios.robot_role: Ferries fasteners and rail stock up to the work zone to cut carry trips.

credential.name: Bayfront Wetland Build Site Readiness Card
